issues.description: Constructor signature for Bitmap24 is inconsistent between the template header, the template implementation, and the solution header. The template header declares Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth) while the template implementation defines Bitmap24::Bitmap24(int p_width, int p_height) (two parameters). The solution header and implementation use the two-parameter constructor (int i_width, int i_height). This mismatch will cause compilation errors or confusion when students try to instantiate Bitmap24 using the header in the template.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor declarations consistent. Either remove the extra 'depth' parameter from example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp in the template (so it declares Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height)) to match the implementation and the solution, or add/implement a corresponding three-argument constructor Bitmap24(int i_width, int i_height, int depth) in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp. Prefer aligning the template header to the two-parameter constructor used in the implementation and solution to avoid breaking builds.
